title: Tiny, cute submarine
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Water around the submarine -->
  <rect x="8" y="60" width="84" height="34" rx="10" fill="#1a3a5c"/>
  <rect x="8" y="60" width="84" height="34" rx="10" fill="#2a5a8c" opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- Submarine hull (body) -->
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="48" rx="32" ry="18" fill="#f5a623"/>
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="48" rx="32" ry="18" fill="#f5c842" opacity="0.4"/>
  <!-- Hull highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="42" cy="42" rx="20" ry="8" fill="#ffdd77" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- Hull bottom shade -->
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="56" rx="28" ry="8" fill="#d4871a" opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- Stripe on hull -->
  <rect x="18" y="44" width="60" height="4" rx="2" fill="#e8734a"/>

  <!-- Periscope tower -->
  <rect x="46" y="24" width="12" height="14" rx="3" fill="#f5a623"/>
  <rect x="46" y="24" width="12" height="14" rx="3" fill="#ffdd77" opacity="0.3"/>
  <!-- Periscope tube -->
  <rect x="54" y="14" width="4" height="12" rx="2" fill="#e8734a"/>
  <!-- Periscope top -->
  <rect x="52" y="12" width="10" height="5" rx="2" fill="#ff6b4a"/>

  <!-- Portholes -->
  <circle cx="34" cy="48" r="5" fill="#1a3a5c"/>
  <circle cx="34" cy="48" r="4" fill="#4ac8f0"/>
  <circle cx="34" cy="48" r="2.5" fill="#a8eaff" opacity="0.7"/>

  <circle cx="48" cy="48" r="5" fill="#1a3a5c"/>
  <circle cx="48" cy="48" r="4" fill="#4ac8f0"/>
  <circle cx="48" cy="48" r="2.5" fill="#a8eaff" opacity="0.7"/>

  <circle cx="62" cy="48" r="5" fill="#1a3a5c"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="48" r="4" fill="#4ac8f0"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="48" r="2.5" fill="#a8eaff" opacity="0.7"/>

  <!-- Tail fin -->
  <polygon points="80,40 92,30 92,50 80,56" fill="#e8734a"/>
  <polygon points="80,40 88,33 88,47 80,56" fill="#ff9a6a" opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- Tail fin top -->
  <polygon points="82,38 90,26 94,32 84,42" fill="#d45a3a"/>
  <!-- Tail fin bottom -->
  <polygon points="82,56 90,68 94,62 84,52" fill="#d45a3a"/>

  <!-- Propeller hub -->
  <circle cx="88" cy="48" r="4" fill="#ff6b4a"/>
  <!-- Propeller blades -->
  <ellipse cx="88" cy="42" rx="2.5" ry="6" fill="#ff9a6a" transform="rotate(0 88 48)"/>
  <ellipse cx="88" cy="54" rx="2.5" ry="6" fill="#ff9a6a" transform="rotate(0 88 48)"/>
  <ellipse cx="82" cy="48" rx="2.5" ry="6" fill="#ff9a6a" transform="rotate(90 88 48)"/>
  <ellipse cx="94" cy="48" rx="2.5" ry="6" fill="#ff9a6a" transform="rotate(90 88 48)"/>

  <!-- Front nose light -->
  <circle cx="17" cy="48" r="3" fill="#ffe44a"/>
  <circle cx="17" cy="48" r="1.5" fill="#fff9cc"/>

  <!-- Bubbles -->
  <circle cx="26" cy="28" r="3" fill="#7ae0ff" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="20" cy="20" r="2" fill="#7ae0ff" opacity="0.5"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="16" r="2.5" fill="#7ae0ff" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="22" cy="12" r="1.5" fill="#7ae0ff" opacity="0.4"/>

  <!-- Water waves -->
  <ellipse cx="30" cy="70" rx="20" ry="4" fill="#3a7abf" opacity="0.6"/>
  <ellipse cx="65" cy="80" rx="22" ry="4" fill="#3a7abf" opacity="0.5"/>
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="88" rx="18" ry="3" fill="#3a7abf" opacity="0.4"/>

  <!-- Seaweed -->
  <path d="M12 94 Q16 80 12 72" stroke="#2e8b57" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M18 94 Q22 82 18 74" stroke="#3cb371" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M90 94 Q86 82 90 74" stroke="#2e8b57" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M84 94 Q80 84 84 76" stroke="#3cb371" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Cute eyes on sub face (front porthole is the eye area) -->
  <circle cx="40" cy="41" r="3" fill="#1a3a5c"/>
  <circle cx="40" cy="41" r="2" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="40" cy="41" r="1" fill="#1a3a5c"/>

  <circle cx="56" cy="41" r="3" fill="#1a3a5c"/>
  <circle cx="56" cy="41" r="2" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="56" cy="41" r="1" fill="#1a3a5c"/>

  <!-- Happy smile -->
  <path d="M42 52 Q48 57 54 52" stroke="#d45a3a" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Blush cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="52" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#ff6b6b" opacity="0.5"/>
  <ellipse cx="60" cy="52" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#ff6b6b" opacity="0.5"/>
</svg>
